content.title: Gratis ICO Konverter & Favicon Generator
content.p1: Opretter du en hjemmeside? Du skal bruge et favicon - det lille ikon, der vises i browserens faner.
content.p2: Vores ICO Konverter transforms any PNG or JPG image into a standard Microsoft `.ico` file. We support all common favicon sizes to ensure your brand looks sharp on every device.

features.title: Key Features
features.f1_desc: Choose from 16x16, 32x32, 48x48, 64x64, or 128x128 pixels. Or select all!
features.f2_desc: Upload a large logo, and we'll automatically downscale it smoothly to fit the tiny icon format.
features.f3_desc: Modern .ico files can contain multiple sizes in one file. We handle that for you.

how_to.title: Steps to Opret Favicon
how_to.step1_desc: Use a square image (PNG/JPG) for best results.

why.title: Hvorfor .ICO format?
why.p1: Mens moderne browsere understøtter PNG-favicons, er `.ico`-formatet stadig standarden for maksimal kompatibilitet på tværs af alle operativsystemer og ældre browsere (som Internet Explorer).
